paragraphs: Andrews Technology sells time and attendance systems that collect and report workforce data in real time. It resells two product lines rather than building its own, representing UKG Ready and NOVAtime. A buyer wanting web-based timesheets or biometric hardware is offered either.

Data collection choices run to badge, proximity, biometric, PC entry, a mobile application and phone entry. Clock hardware in the catalogue includes the NT8000 smart time clock. Scheduling is covered by a module called Advanced Scheduling Manager. The company promises unlimited training and support around the clock.

Johnston County, North Carolina, is named as a new workforce management partner. The City of Tipton, Indiana, selected the company for a workforce management solution. The City of Sapulpa, Oklahoma, chose it for a workforce management implementation. The business gives an address in Wilmington, North Carolina.
